title: Build Pretend Play
hook: Change the story when the next idea arrives.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D playroom storybook, rounded safe toys, simple uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Build Pretend Play

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child revising a pretend-play world
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Build Pretend Play about affordances: construction pieces build structures, figures carry stories, vehicles suggest routes, and open-ended objects can change roles without claiming a toy has one correct story.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child builds a tiny world, then changes the story while keeping physical constraints and small-part safety visible.
